prompt: One batch of muffins uses $\frac{3}{4}$ cup of flour. How much flour do $5$ batches need? (mixed number)
hint: Five copies of $\frac{3}{4}$ — that is multiplication.

hints.text: Five copies of $\frac{3}{4}$ — that is multiplication.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Two batches would take $\frac{3}{4} + \frac{3}{4} = \frac{6}{4} = 1\frac{1}{2}$ cups. Same idea for 5.

explanation: Five batches need $3\frac{3}{4}$ cups of flour.
